steps.title: The 10 plate: extrude the 10 plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as ten_plate.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 75 by 45.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Distance 10 (the leader note says 10 PLATE). OK.

steps.title: The 10 plate: cut the 10 x 5 step
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a rectangle 10 wide and 5 deep at the top left corner.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Cut, Through All. OK. The left edge is now 40 high.

steps.title: The 10 plate: cut the corner notch
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a rectangle from 59 along the top (10 + 49) to the right end, down to 23 above the base (12 + 11).
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.title: The 10 plate: R10 in the notch
actions: Fillet: Radius 10, select the inside corner edge of the notch. OK.

steps.title: The 10 plate: chamfer the corner 12 x 45 degrees
actions: Chamfer: Equal distance 12, select the bottom right edge. OK. The angle between the chamfer and the base is 135 degrees, as dimensioned.

steps.title: The 10 plate: hole 10 diameter
actions: Hole: Placement = on the front face, 10 from the left and 10 from the bottom. Simple hole, diameter 10, Through All. OK. Save.
